title: Square of the expectation is at most the expectation of the square
statement:
Let $\Omega$ be a finite measurable space, let $\mu$ be a probability measure on $\Omega$, and let $f : \Omega \to \bbr$ be any real-valued function. Then
\[
  \Bigl(\int_\Omega f\,d\mu\Bigr)^{2} \;\le\; \int_\Omega f^{2}\,d\mu.
\]
hypotheses_covered: Ω is a finite measurable space
μ is a probability measure on Ω
f is a real-valued function on Ω
